what: db to cargo: (1) Review of 01533: serve.rs ignores every Err of blaze_query::on_each_run. Ignore it only when the returned hook is blaze_profile::moved (a second daemon in one process); another hook already set is an error naming it, else the stall watchdog silently counts nothing (no-fallback). (2) Your outside-reads request (19:11): hir_def::deps::outside_reads(db, krate) -> Result<ContentId, Refused> is in deps/filed.rs (someone wrote the same fn at the same time; one copy kept, READS_DOMAIN import added, exported from deps.rs). It hashes checked_reads (env! variables plus traced expansions, with values) and, for a crate served from an image, the image filed key. Call it after the crate check (the env! log must have the bodies reads); Err is an expansion of unknown reads, which no record can cover. Test deps::tests::outside_reads_follow_the_values_read. Unbuilt.

history.note: (1) serve.rs: on_each_run is set once per process behind a OnceLock<bool>, so a second daemon reuses the first result and a hook something else set first is an error (bail). It does not compare against blaze_profile::moved: OnceLock::set hands back the hook passed in, not the one already set, and fn-pointer comparison is unreliable. (2) compile.rs store phase: checked_reads Err (an untraced expansion) leaves the unit record unkept, logged with the reason, under span `unit expansion reads`. Remaining gap, in lane 11 reads.rs: unit records are filed only by env! names, so traced proc-macro reads are never re-checked at lookup; filing should build on hir_def checked_reads/find_by_reads. rust-analyzer clean; unbuilt.
